mapper.select:
WITH hit AS ( SELECT 'task'::text AS kind, t.task_id AS id, t.task_name AS title, coalesce(t.description, '') AS snippet, t.task_id AS task_id, NULL::text AS section_id, NULL::text AS bank_id, NULL::text AS dem_key, 1.0::float8 AS w_field, t.updated_at AS updated_at, NULL::float8 AS lng, NULL::float8 AS lat, CASE WHEN t.task_name = #{exact,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 3.0 WHEN t.task_name ILIKE #{prefix,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END AS w_match FROM tasks t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND (t.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} OR #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) AND (t.task_name ILIKE #{pattern,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR t.description ILIKE #{pattern,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'bank'::text, b.bank_id, b.bank_name, coalesce(b.description, ''), NULL::text, NULL::text, b.bank_id, NULL::text, 0.9::float8, b.updated_at, NULL::float8, NULL::float8, CASE WHEN b.bank_name = #{exact,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 3.0 WHEN b.bank_name ILIKE #{prefix,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END FROM banks b WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL AND (b.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} OR #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) AND b.bank_name ILIKE #{pattern,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'section'::text, s.section_id, s.section_name, coalesce(s.param_name, ''), s.task_id, s.section_id, s.bank_id, NULL::text, 0.8::float8, s.updated_at, ST_X(ST_Centroid(s.geom)), ST_Y(ST_Centroid(s.geom)), CASE WHEN s.section_name = #{exact,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 3.0 WHEN s.section_name ILIKE #{prefix,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END FROM cross_sections s WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND (s.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} OR #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) AND (s.section_name ILIKE #{pattern,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR s.param_name ILIKE #{pattern,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND s.task_id = #{taskId}
AND s.bank_id = #{bankId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bank_risk_results rr WHERE rr.section_id = s.section_id AND rr.deleted_at IS NULL AND rr.risk_level = #{riskLevel} )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dem'::text, d.dem_id, d.dem_title, 'DEM 资源', d.task_id, NULL::text, NULL::text, d.dem_id, 0.75::float8, d.updated_at, NULL::float8, NULL::float8, CASE WHEN d.dem_title = #{exact,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 3.0 WHEN d.dem_title ILIKE #{prefix,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (sp.dem_id) sp.dem_id, regexp_replace(sp.dem_id, '^.*/', '') AS dem_title, sp.task_id, sp.updated_at FROM section_profiles sp WHERE sp.deleted_at IS NULL AND (sp.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} OR #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) AND sp.dem_id ILIKE #{pattern,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY sp.dem_id, sp.updated_at DESC ) d
UNION ALL
SELECT 'note'::text, n.section_id, coalesce(n.section_name, n.section_id), n.note, n.task_id, n.section_id, NULL::text, NULL::text, 0.7::float8, n.updated_at, NULL::float8, NULL::float8, CASE WHEN n.note = #{exact,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 3.0 WHEN n.note ILIKE #{prefix,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.section_id) r.section_id, r.section_name, r.edit_state ->> 'note' AS note, r.task_id, r.run_time AS updated_at FROM bank_risk_results r WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND (r.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} OR #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) AND coalesce(r.edit_state ->> 'note', '') ILIKE #{pattern,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY r.section_id, r.id DESC ) n
UNION ALL
SELECT 'report'::text, rp.run_id, coalesce(rp.report_file_name, rp.run_id), coalesce(rp.last_error, ''), rp.task_id, NULL::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, 0.7::float8, rp.updated_at, NULL::float8, NULL::float8, CASE WHEN rp.report_file_name = #{exact,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 3.0 WHEN rp.report_file_name ILIKE #{prefix,jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.0 END FROM ai_report_runs rp WHERE (rp.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} OR #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL) AND rp.report_file_name ILIKE #{pattern,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ), ranked AS ( SELECT h.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.kind, h.title ORDER BY (h.w_field * h.w_match) DESC, h.updated_at DESC) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY h.kind, h.title) AS dup FROM hit h ) SELECT kind, id, title, left(snippet, 160) AS snippet, task_id, section_id, bank_id, dem_key, round((w_field * w_match)::numeric, 4)::float8 AS score, lng, lat, updated_at, dup AS duplicate_count FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3
AND kind IN
#{t}
ORDER BY score DESC, updated_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit}
